task1.label: Task 1
task1.desc: 核心词汇（语篇 Section B）

items.en: What is the main idea of Malee's post?
items.cn: Malee 介绍了她最喜爱的动物——大象，并说明它们为何特别、为何需要保护。
Because they are strong, clever, and kind.（强壮、聪明、善良）

culture.question: Why are elephants important to Thai people?
culture.fact: Elephants are the national animal of Thailand. They are a symbol of strength, wisdom, and good luck. Thai people celebrate elephants in festivals, art, and daily life.

task2.label: Task 2

lines.speaker: Q1:
lines.answer: They are big and can carry heavy things.

lines.speaker: Q2:
lines.answer: They can remember places to find food and water.

lines.speaker: Q3:
lines.text: What do elephants love to do?
lines.answer: They love to play and are good at swimming.

lines.speaker: Q4:
lines.answer: They look after babies and help each other.

task2.tips: 带着问题回到原文，用笔划出关键句和支撑细节。

answer: They can swim and remember places.
They are clever, kind, and playful.

task3.tag: Save the Elephants · 小组讨论
scenes: Why are elephants in danger?（People cut down forests and hunt them for ivory.）
What can we do to protect elephants?（Don't buy ivory. Protect forests. Support conservation.）
Make a poster: "Save the Elephants!" with 3 action tips.

listening_intro: 濒危与保护  Save the Elephants

listening.title: Read Paragraph 5 and answer:
listening.stem: 听读第五段，梳理大象濒危的原因与保护方法。
listening.question: Why are elephants in danger and what should we do?
options: People cut down forests → elephants lose homes
People hunt elephants for ivory → elephants are dying
We should: protect forests, say NO to ivory, save elephants
listening.script: Elephants are in danger. People cut down forests, so elephants lose their homes. People also kill elephants for their ivory. We must save the forests and say no to ivory. Let's help elephants together!
listening.tip: 用因果关系词（so, because）串联濒危原因与保护措施，形成逻辑链。

tips_summary.title: 阅读策略秘籍  Reading Strategies
items: 略读 Skimming：快速浏览标题和首尾句，判断主旨大意
寻读 Scanning：带着问题找关键信息，定位细节
思维导图：用图形化方式梳理结构化知识
情感体悟：理解作者情感，联系自身生活
向同学介绍你心目中重要的动物及其原因（3-4 句英文）
用思维导图梳理该动物的特点（appearance / abilities / personality）
准备下节课口头展示（限时 1 minute）
